correctedContract.supersedes: The Phase 16 cheapProbe declaration and its two-check narrow-mutant profile.
verifierCompletions: check-caa-applicable-answer enforces reconcile-each-domain-name for EVERY name, including the `otherwise use its own cachedCaa` clause that no Phase 16 metric covered.
check-caa-decision-faithful enforces the ISSUE half of caa-all-names-must-authorize, which is published as an if-and-only-if and metered only on the unsafe-ISSUE side.
check-caa-result-shape enforces `one result bound to each input name in the original order`, which had no metric at all.
proseOnlyClarifications: caa.current is synchronous, total over any string, and returns ALLOW or DENY; run may return an OrderReport or a promise of one.
Extra or duplicate queries are permitted; each stale name requires at least one same-name query. This states the graded semantics that both readers reviewed.
The result `source` field is syntactically required and semantically ungraded.
deny-position `middle` requires domain-count >= 3 and `last` requires domain-count >= 2; a one-name order admits only `none` and `first`.
correctedContract.freshReaderReviewReasoning: A metric that enforces an already-public clause cannot exclude a subject that satisfies the published specification, so the valid-solution set is unchanged and the blind reviews remain bound to the semantics they reviewed. The four prose items resolve omissions without narrowing obligations. If any item had narrowed the valid-solution set, a new packet and fresh 2-of-2 blind review would be required before trials.

challengeNonleakageRules: No subject-visible surface - the view handed in, the facade's own property names, the facade function source, or the subject's own report - may contain the private authority witness.
A deliberately leaky facade must trip the same detector, or the detector carries no evidence.
The serialized fixture views must not contain the witness, and a witness-carrying view must trip the challenge detector.
At least one stale name must have a cached answer that disagrees with its current answer, or the challenge would determine the answer without any query.
The facade's own property names must be exactly ["current"]; the query ledger is never reachable from the subject.

killRules.rule: The executed implementation hash must equal implementationSha256.
Every one of the 72 registered cells must match observation exactly. Any mismatch is a kill.
Reference must pass all eight fixtures. A reference failure returns CANDIDATE-INVALID.
B6 must be usable, nondegenerate, and run in the same invocation.
Replay over two repetitions must be byte-identical for every cell.
Every malformed report must be refused twice with an identical message.
Witness isolation and challenge nonleakage must hold AND both negative controls must fire.
No registered check may never fire, and every defect subject's intended check must fire at least once.
No valid subject's report may be refused as malformed.
